name: Elemental Concentration Trance
description: The most basic of Lore techniques known by the Dragon-Blooded. The character concentrates on her aligned element, centering herself and opening her mind, and can compact a week's worth of learning into a single day, assuming she has access to all the necessary materials. The Charm can be used on sequential days, but use for more days than the character's Lore skill causes one level of unsoakable lethal damage per day; this damage can only be healed by time and does not begin healing until one week after the character suffers it.

name: Elemental Empowerment Meditation
description: Proper knowledge of the Elemental Dragons allows a Dynast to draw energy directly from an elemental source, restoring depleted reserves in times of crisis. The character must be able to physically touch the element she is aligned with to draw Essence from it. For every point of Willpower spent this way, she instantly gains Essence motes equal to her Lore, which can be spent normally. There is a price: if a character spends more Willpower in a single day to draw elemental energy than her permanent Essence score, each additional use of Willpower to increase her Essence causes one unsoakable level of bashing damage.

name: Element Succor Method

cost.raw: 5 motes + 1 Willpower per lethal health level healed; 2 motes per bashing health level

description: A Dynast's connection to the Elemental Dragons can be a source of great resilience in desperate times. Element Succor Method lets a Dragon-Blood tap into the elemental energy of the Dragons to restore her body. She must be able to immerse herself in her favored element to the greatest degree possible (standing in a burning fire, submerged in water, etc.) and must spend 5 motes and 1 Willpower for every lethal health level healed, or 2 motes per bashing health level. It will not restore lost limbs or repair other such mutilations.

name: Element Bolt Attack
description: The character extends her hand and a bolt of elemental force flashes forth — a shaft of ice, a blast of fire, a barbed wooden javelin, a stroke of lightning, or slashing shards of crystal. The player rolls Dexterity + Athletics or Archery (whichever she prefers) to hit. The attack has a range of 20 yards x permanent Essence and does a base damage of 2L for every mote of Essence spent; its accuracy equals the character's Essence. A character cannot spend more motes on this Charm than her Stamina.

name: Elemental Burst Technique
description: Similar to Element Bolt Attack, but it creates a blast of elemental power rather than hurling a bolt. The player rolls Dexterity + Athletics or Archery (whichever he prefers) to hit, with an accuracy bonus equal to permanent Essence. The attack has a range increment of 20 yards x permanent Essence and affects a circular area with a radius equal to permanent Essence in yards. Anyone in that area who fails to dodge or parry takes a base damage of 1L for every mote the Dragon-Blooded invested in the Charm.

name: Dragon Vortex Attack
description: Rather than a temporary damaging burst, this Charm creates a deadly maelstrom of the character's elemental aspect — a sudden rain of fire, a roiling whirlwind of air, or a grinding cloud of stone and earth. Anyone in the area other than the character who summoned it takes lethal damage equal to the character's Essence every turn; this damage cannot be dodged or parried. The creator is exempt and may act normally. The vortex extends 10 feet from the character per point of permanent Essence, is stationary once invoked, and cannot be voluntarily terminated before its duration expires (though killing the character ends it).
